That pair has had 52% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 71:15 together, about what it had with Blankenburg (48%).

story.head: The Maple Leafs are desperate for a win
paras: The Maple Leafs are winless in eight (0-7-1), while the Blue Jackets (8-12-0) beat Chicago 4-2 on Thursday. The Maple Leafs won the teams’ first meeting this season, 6-2 in Columbus on Oct 20. Both teams are near the bottom of the standings. Going in, the Jackets are seventh in the Metropolitan (tied for 28th in the NHL) and the Maple Leafs last in the Atlantic (tied for 26th).

The Blue Jackets have played better than their record (.400) says: their chances are worth about .492, and their finishing has held them back. So have the Maple Leafs (.396 on chances worth .483), mostly because they’re 3-9 in one-goal games.

The Blue Jackets get their defensemen shooting (3rd) and do a lot of their shooting from distance (3rd lowest). They also forecheck as hard as almost anyone (3rd), so the Blue Jackets have the edge over the Maple Leafs on forecheck pressure. Columbus has scored 2.40 goals a game, the fewest in the league. The Maple Leafs get their shots through better than anyone (1st), but have had shaky goaltending (31st) and take a lot of low-quality shots (31st). The Maple Leafs’ power play (10th) could do real damage against the Blue Jackets’ penalty kill (23rd).

Kent Johnson (9 G / 12 A / 21 P in 20 GP) leads the Blue Jackets in scoring, and Zach Werenski (4 G / 14 A / 18 P in 20 GP) isn’t far behind. Auston Matthews (13 G / 19 A / 32 P in 24 GP) leads the Maple Leafs in scoring and is tied for sixth in the NHL, with eight goals in nine games against Columbus since 2023-24. William Nylander (11 G / 13 A / 24 P in 24 GP) isn’t far behind.

Columbus has two options in net: Cam Talbot (6-4-0 / .907 SV% in 10 GS) and Jet Greaves (2-8-0 / .875 SV% in 10 GS). They have split the last ten starts, and Talbot got the last one on Thursday. Toronto also has two options: Anthony Stolarz (5-4-1 / .904 SV% in 10 GS) and Sergei Bobrovsky (3-9-2 / .873 SV% in 14 GS). They have split the last ten starts, and Stolarz got the last one on Thursday. For both teams, it’s anyone’s guess who gets the net.
